:::{#exm-cdf-pois}
#### Computing Poisson cumulative probabilities

For a Poisson random variable $X \sim \Pois(\mean = 2)$,
the probability of observing at most 2 events is computed as:

$$
\ba
\P(X \le 2)
&= e^{-2} \sum_{j=0}^{2} \frac{2^j}{j!} && (\text{apply CDF formula with } \mean = 2, y = 2) \\
&= e^{-2} \paren{\frac{2^0}{0!} + \frac{2^1}{1!} + \frac{2^2}{2!}} && (\text{expand terms for } j = 0, 1, 2) \\
&= e^{-2} \paren{1 + 2 + 2} && (\text{simplify factorials and powers}) \\
&= 5 e^{-2} \approx 0.677 && (\text{evaluate numerical value})
\ea
$$
:::
